content.title: FelixJump DX
about: Deluxe iteration of the FelixJump mobile project, based on the original team repository.
Aimed at expanding content and polishing the user experience for mobile.
Worked on gameplay improvements and integration tasks across the project.
learnings: Mobile-first input & UI constraints (touch targets, readability, aspect ratios).
Iterating quickly with Git branching, code reviews, and frequent integration.
Balancing performance and visuals for mobile builds (profiling, lightweight effects).
